'''I-M3''' was the designation of a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] deployed on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Galactic War]]. The droid was destroyed in combat, but its remains were scavenged by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Technician/Legends|technicians]]. Despite being dismembered, the neural processor of the droid was still functional. While technicians continued to work on it, the droid assumed it was still in Imperial hands and relayed to a Republic citizen its last mission - to recover [[Shadow Squadron (Sith Empire)|Shadow Squadron]] transponders from their crash sites.
